_source: Core Rulebook, Barbarian (d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/barbarian/ and legacy.aonprd.com/coreRulebook/classes/barbarian.html, both read 2026-10-05).

abilities.name: Rage
abilities.source: CRB p.31 Rage: +4 morale Str and Con, +2 morale Will, -2 AC; free action to enter; cannot enter while fatigued or exhausted; fatigued for 2 rounds per round raged. Greater rage (11th) +6/+3, mighty rage (20th) +8/+4, tireless rage (17th) no fatigue.
abilities.text: +4 Str and Con, +2 Will, -2 AC; a round a round; fatigued after.

addons._source: CRB rage power: a bite while raging, 1d4 (1d3 if Small).
CRB rage power: a 5-foot enhancement bonus to speed while raging.
CRB rage power: her level as an enhancement bonus on Climb while raging.
CRB rage power: her level as an enhancement bonus on Swim while raging.

CRB rage power: +2 morale on saves against spells, +1 per 4 levels. Only saves made against a spell carry the context (the cast door passes against: spell); supernatural and spell-like abilities do not yet.

not_yet: "Any ability that requires patience or concentration": only skills are refused while it holds; casting and concentration are not.
Indomitable will's +4 against enchantment: saves carry no enchantment descriptor yet.
Rounds only drain in played rounds; a rage begun out of a fight holds until it is ended.

abilities.name: Guarded Stance
abilities.source: CRB rage power: +1 dodge AC against melee for Con modifier rounds (minimum 1), +1 for every 6 levels; a move action while raging.
abilities.text: +1 dodge AC against melee for Con-modifier rounds, while raging.

abilities.name: Rolling Dodge
abilities.source: CRB rage power: +1 dodge AC against ranged attacks for Con modifier rounds, +1 for every 6 levels; a move action while raging.
abilities.text: +1 dodge AC against ranged attacks for Con-modifier rounds, while raging.
abilities.tell: {name} weaves low, hard to draw a bead on.

abilities.name: Renewed Vigor
abilities.source: CRB rage power: a standard action while raging, once a day: heal 1d8 + Con modifier, +1d8 for every four levels above 4th (5d8 at 20th).
abilities.text: Heal 1d8 + Con while raging, once a day.
